results.title: Results
results.intro: Every strategic goal against every reporting period, read from the indicator cards beneath it.
results.gridAria: Results matrix. Strategic goals down the side, reporting periods across the top. Use the arrow keys to move between cells.
results.cellAria: {goal}, {period}. {rag}, {share} of indicators on target, {reported} reported. Trend: {trend}.
results.cellAriaNoData: {goal}, {period}. No indicator of this cadence reported.
results.trendHint: The arrow compares the cell with the period before it.
results.emptyHint: No indicator of this cadence has reported an actual yet. Try another cadence.
results.narrativeSource: Written from the reported figures on this page, with no model in the loop.

narrative.none: No strategic goal has reported for {period} yet.
narrative.lead: In {period}, {onTarget} of the {total} strategic goals that reported are on target.
narrative.improvedMany: {count, plural, one {# goal} other {# goals}} improved against the previous period, {goal} among them.
narrative.behind: {goal} carries {count, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}} behind target.
narrative.behindUnder: {goal} carries {count, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}} behind target, all of them under {node}.
narrative.allClear: Every goal that reported this period is on target.
narrative.silent: {count, plural, one {One further goal has} other {A further # goals have}} no reported figure for this period.

results.dialogEmpty: No indicator of this cadence sits beneath this goal.
results.sparkAria: Target and actual over time for {indicator}.
results.sparkLegend: Solid line: actual. Dashed line: target. The gold mark is the period in focus.

situation.title: Situation analysis
situation.hint: Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, the stakeholder map, the challenges and the baseline.
situation.stakeholderHint: Interest against influence. Hover a dot or move to it with the keyboard to read the full entry.
situation.stakeholderAria: Stakeholder map. Influence on the horizontal axis and interest on the vertical axis, both from 1 to 5.
situation.noStakeholders: No stakeholder has been recorded yet.
situation.challengesEmpty: No challenge has been recorded yet.
situation.baselineEmpty: The baseline has not been written yet.

implementation.title: Implementation plan
implementation.hint: Every project on one timeline, grouped by the department that owns it.

me.title: Monitoring and evaluation framework
me.hint: What is measured, how often, and when the next figures are due.
me.laneEmpty: No indicator reports on this cadence.
me.calendarHint: The next twelve moments at which figures are due, counted from today.
me.calendarEmpty: No indicator has a reporting cadence yet.
me.reportingCount: {count, plural, one {# indicator reports} other {# indicators report}}

risks.title: Risk register
risks.hint: Where the risks sit on likelihood and impact, and what is being done about them.
risks.heatHint: Choose a square to read only the risks that sit there. Choose it again to clear the filter.
risks.heatAria: Risk heat map. Impact from 5 down to 1 on the rows, likelihood from 1 to 5 across the columns.
risks.axes: Likelihood runs across, impact runs up, both on a scale of 1 to 5.
risks.changeStatusAria: Change the status of the risk {risk}
risks.emptyHint: No risk sits on that square.

governance.title: Governance
governance.hint: The bodies that steer the strategy and the people who sit on them.
governance.empty: No governance body has been recorded yet.

priority.title: Prioritisation matrix
priority.hint: Impact against feasibility, one dot for every project.
priority.hintEditable: Impact against feasibility. Drag a project to a new square, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Every move is saved at once.
priority.aria: Prioritisation matrix. Feasibility from 1 to 5 on the horizontal axis, impact from 1 to 5 on the vertical axis.
priority.dotAria: {code}, {title}. Impact {impact} of 5, feasibility {feasibility} of 5. Status: {status}. Use the arrow keys to move it.
priority.unplaced: {count, plural, one {One project has} other {# projects have}} no position on this matrix yet: {codes}.
